name: 1/f noise with alpha, sonar (onef)
plain: FFT filter over height and width with the exponent as a parameter. Pinkish and greenish names exist as preset alphas, mix variants subtract two draws.
math:
P=(fx²+fy²)^(−α/2); if k≠0: P=k/P; P(0,0)=base_power. F=fftn(ε); F←F/√P (or /P); out=Re ifftn(F).
Amplitude ∝ |f|^(−α/2)/√k for k≠0.
ONEF_PINKISH α=−.5; ONEF_GREENISH α=.5. Mix: ½(−n₁+n₂) of same alpha.
Then normalized.

props.spectrum: power law with sign from α

label: from code
surprise: Working through the code, onef_pinkish (α=−.5) multiplies amplitude by |f|^+.25, so it raises high frequencies, unlike usual pink noise.
